items.text: Mumbai is India's financial capital through BKC, Nariman Point, and Lower Parel, and its only real entertainment and media capital through the Andheri-Versova-Goregaon production belt - a fork no other Indian city forces this sharply.

The goal is getting clear before more time and money go the wrong way, and building the kind of high-value skill portfolio that unlocks high income opportunities and moves you toward earlier financial freedom, whichever track actually fits.
